title: THURSDAY INTERVALS
subtitle: THURSDAY. INTERVALS. STEP UPS, TIMED PUSH UPS ON THE FIFTH, MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS, SIDE PLANK BALANCE, THEN CAT-COW AND WALL CHEST OPENER. SHORT WORK. SHORT REST. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. THURSDAY. INTERVALS. SIXTEEN MINUTES. STEP UPS, TIMED PUSH UPS ON THE FIFTH STAIR, MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS, SIDE PLANK FOR BALANCE, THEN WE OPEN THE SPINE AND CHEST. SHORT WORK. SHORT REST. THAT CHAIR HAS MADE YOU SOFT AND SLOW. WE FIX THE PACE. MOVE.
script.start: MOVE. CLOCK IS RUNNING. YOU ARE NOT.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. THAT INBOX CAN WAIT, IT'S NOT GOING ANYWHERE AND NEITHER ARE YOU.
script.lastSet: LAST SET. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. INTERVALS DONE, BALANCE TESTED, SPINE AND CHEST OPENED. GOOD THURSDAY. NOW GO SIT DOWN WITHOUT TURNING INTO A BLOODY FOLDED DECKCHAIR.

exercises.name: STEP UPS (INTERVALS)
exercises.cue: USE A STURDY LOW STAIR OR STEP. STEP ONE FOOT UP, DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL TO STAND TALL ON THE STEP, THEN STEP DOWN WITH CONTROL. ALTERNATE LEAD LEGS. THIRTY SECONDS CONTINUOUS. CHEST UP. NO STOMPING. THIS IS YOUR INTERVAL PACE — STEADY AND HONEST, NOT A BLOODY STAMPEDE.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. THREE SETS. THIRTY SECONDS. UP. STAND TALL. DOWN WITH CONTROL. ALTERNATE LEGS. KEEP THE PACE. THIS IS AN INTERVAL, NOT A NAP.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. CATCH YOUR BREATH. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: STEP UPS DONE. LEGS AWAKE. GOOD.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH UPS (FIFTH STAIR, TIMED)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FIFTH STAIR — ABOUT FORTY INCHES. BODY IN ONE LONG LINE FROM HEAD TO HEELS. LOWER THE CHEST TOWARD THE STEP, ELBOWS ABOUT FORTY-FIVE FROM THE RIBS, THEN PRESS UP. THIRTY SECONDS CONTINUOUS. DO NOT DROP TO A LOWER STEP. QUALITY REPS, NOT FLOPPY ONES. IF YOU NEED A BREATH, HOLD THE TOP PLANK BRIEFLY THEN CONTINUE.
exercises.speakStart: PUSH UPS. FIFTH STAIR. THREE SETS. THIRTY SECONDS. LONG LINE. LOWER. PRESS. DO NOT DROP THE STEP. I'M WATCHING. KEEP THEM CLEAN.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE ARMS. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: PUSH UPS DONE. CHEST HONEST. GOOD.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS (INTERVALS)
exercises.cue: HIGH PLANK ON THE FLOOR OR HANDS ON A LOW STURDY SURFACE IF THE WRISTS PREFER IT. DRIVE ONE KNEE TOWARD THE CHEST, THEN THE OTHER, ALTERNATING — LIKE RUNNING IN PLACE IN A PLANK. TWENTY SECONDS. HIPS LEVEL. DO NOT BOUNCE THE BACKSIDE UP. SHORT INTERVAL. STAY TIGHT.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. THREE SETS. TWENTY SECONDS. PLANK. DRIVE THE KNEES. HIPS LEVEL. THIS IS THE INTERVAL BURN. DO NOT TURN IT INTO A BLOODY WIGGLE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. BREATHE. EYES ON YOU.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK (BALANCE)
exercises.cue: ON YOUR SIDE, FOREARM DOWN, ELBOW UNDER THE SHOULDER. STACK OR STAGGER THE FEET. LIFT THE HIPS INTO A STRAIGHT LINE — HEAD TO HEELS. HOLD ABOUT FIVE SECONDS, LOWER WITH CONTROL, REPEAT THREE HOLDS EACH SIDE. KNEE-DOWN IS LEGAL IF YOU NEED IT. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE. NO SAGGING HIPS.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANK. TWO ROUNDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH HOLD. THREE HOLDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM DOWN. HIPS UP. STRAIGHT LINE. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE. DO NOT COLLAPSE LIKE A BLOODY DECKCHAIR.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. SWITCH SIDES WHEN READY. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.cue: ON ALL FOURS, WRISTS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. INHALE — DROP THE BELLY, LIFT THE CHEST AND TAIL (COW). EXHALE — ROUND THE BACK, TUCK THE CHIN AND PELVIS (CAT). EIGHT SLOW REPS. MOVE WITH THE BREATH. NO FORCING. THIS UNWINDS THE SPINE AFTER THOSE INTERVALS.
exercises.speakStart: CAT COW. TWO ROUNDS. EIGHT SLOW. INHALE COW. EXHALE CAT. WITH THE BREATH. THAT SPINE HAS BEEN LOCKED IN A CHAIR ALL MORNING. WAKE IT UP.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: STAND SIDE-ON TO AN OPEN WALL. PLACE THE FOREARM AND OPEN HAND ON THE WALL AT ABOUT SHOULDER HEIGHT, ELBOW SOFT. GENTLY TURN THE CHEST AWAY FROM THE WALL UNTIL YOU FEEL A STRETCH ACROSS THE CHEST AND FRONT OF THE SHOULDER. HOLD THIRTY SECONDS. SWITCH. EASY PRESSURE — NO FORCING. RIBS DOWN.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL. TURN THE CHEST AWAY. GENTLE. THOSE PUSH UPS WORKED THE FRONT. NOW WE OPEN IT BEFORE THAT DESK HUNCH SETTLES BACK IN.
exercises.speakDone: CHEST OPEN. THAT IS THE LOT. WELL DONE.
